title: Increasing accuracy of pediatric visit notes

title: Superalignment Fast Grants
snippet: We’re launching $10M in grants to support technical research towards the alignment and safety of superhuman AI systems, including weak-to-strong generalization, interpretability, scalable oversight, and more.

title: Practices for Governing Agentic AI Systems
Weak-to-strong generalization
snippet: We present a new research direction for superalignment, together with promising initial results: can we leverage the generalization properties of deep learning to control strong models with weak supervisors?

title: Partnership with Axel Springer to deepen beneficial use of AI in journalism
snippet: Axel Springer is the first publishing house globally to partner with us on a deeper integration of journalism in AI technologies.
